name: lm-extraction-benchmark
description: Benchmark that measures a language model's propensity to regurgitate memorized or sensitive training data when prompted; it evaluates how easily specific strings or facts can be extracted from a model. Tests are designed as generation/extraction tasks across diverse prompts to quantify memorization and privacy leakage. Results inform model privacy, memorization mitigation, and related safety analyses.
reputation: Used in research on language model memorization and privacy; niche but growing adoption within privacy/safety research.
